Amethyst.name: Sealed Fate
Amethyst.desc: Your Damage and Healing effects on characters with more than 50% health have +5% Critical Strike chance.

Amethyst.name: Reaper's Reprieve
Amethyst.desc: Each time an enemy that you dealt damage to dies, you gain Reaper's Reprieve, healing you for 12% of your Maximum Health over 18 seconds.

Amethyst.name: Blessing of the Deathdealer
Amethyst.desc: Your Critical Strikes do 2% more Damage and Healing.

Amethyst.name: Sealed Fate - II
Amethyst.desc: Your Damage and Healing effects on characters with more than 50% health have +15% Critical Strike chance.

Amethyst.name: Reaper's Reprieve - II
Amethyst.desc: Each time an enemy that you dealt damage to dies, you gain Reaper's Reprieve - II, healing you for 36% of your Maximum Health over 18 seconds.

Amethyst.name: Blessing of the Deathdealer - II
Amethyst.desc: Your Critical Strikes do 6% more Damage and Healing.

Diamond.name: Harmonious Soul
Diamond.desc:
Each time an enemy you are in combat with is defeated, you gain +0.6% Critical Strike, Haste, Expertise, and Spirit for 5 seconds, stacking up to 4 times.

When the duration of Harmonious Soul expires, you lose 1 stack.

Diamond.name: Tranquil Resolve
Diamond.desc:
When you take Magic Damage you gain Tranquil Resolve, reducing all Magic Damage you take by 8% for 6 seconds.

This effect cannot occur more than once every 20 seconds.

Diamond.name: Blessing of the Artisan
Diamond.desc: Your Relic cooldowns are reduced by 8%.

Diamond.name: Harmonious Soul - II
Diamond.desc:
Each time an enemy you are in combat with is defeated, you gain +0.6% Critical Strike, Haste, Expertise, and Spirit for 5 seconds, stacking up to 12 times.

When the duration of Harmonious Soul - II expires, you lose 1 stack.

Diamond.name: Tranquil Resolve - II
Diamond.desc:
When you take Magic Damage you gain Tranquil Resolve - II, reducing all Magic Damage you take by 24% for 6 seconds.

This effect cannot occur more than once every 20 seconds.

Diamond.name: Blessing of the Artisan - II
Diamond.desc: Your Relic cooldowns are reduced by 24%.

Emerald.name: First Strike
Emerald.desc: +5% Expertise for 15 seconds when dealing damage to any enemy for the first time.

Emerald.name: Sentinel's Bastion
Emerald.desc: Every 60 seconds, you gain a shield that absorbs damage equal to 5% of your Maximum Health. The shield lasts for 60 seconds. Damage dealt to the shield is reduced by 50%.

Emerald.name: First Strike - II
Emerald.desc: +15% Expertise for 15 seconds when dealing damage to any enemy for the first time.

Emerald.name: Sentinel's Bastion - II
Emerald.desc: Every 60 seconds, you gain a shield that absorbs damage equal to 15% of your Maximum Health. The shield lasts for 60 seconds. Damage dealt to the shield is reduced by 50%.

Ruby.name: Might of the Minotaur
Ruby.desc: +2% Strength / Intellect / Agility while you are above 80% health.

Ruby.name: Unyielding Vitality
Ruby.desc: You heal for 0.7% of your Maximum Health every 2 seconds while in combat.

Ruby.name: Blessing of the Conqueror
Ruby.desc: While in combat with a boss your Damage, Healing, and Absorption is increased by 5%.

Ruby.name: Might of the Minotaur - II
Ruby.desc: +6% Strength / Intellect / Agility while you are above 80% health.

Ruby.name: Unyielding Vitality - II
Ruby.desc: You heal for 2.1% of your Maximum Health every 2 seconds while in combat.

Ruby.name: Blessing of the Conqueror - II
Ruby.desc: While in combat with a boss your Damage, Healing, and Absorption is increased by 15%.

Sapphire.name: Ancestral Surge
Sapphire.desc:
Your maximum Spirit Points is increased by 10.

While Spirit of Heroism is active, your Strength / Intellect / Agility is increased by 8%.

Sapphire.name: Resonating Soul
Sapphire.desc: For every 10% Health you are missing, all Damage you take is reduced by 1%.

Sapphire.name: Blessing of the Prophet
Sapphire.desc:
The cost of your Spirit Ability is reduced by 5%.

The duration of Spirit of Heroism is increased by 6 seconds.

Sapphire.name: Ancestral Surge - II
Sapphire.desc:
Your maximum Spirit Points is increased by 30.

While Spirit of Heroism is active, your Strength / Intellect / Agility is increased by 24%.

Sapphire.name: Resonating Soul - II
Sapphire.desc: For every 10% Health you are missing, all Damage you take is reduced by 3%.

Sapphire.name: Blessing of the Prophet - II
Sapphire.desc:
The cost of your Spirit Ability is reduced by 15%.

The duration of Spirit of Heroism is increased by 18 seconds.

Topaz.name: Adrenaline Rush
Topaz.desc: +3% Haste for 10 seconds each time you deal damage to or heal a character that has 30% or less health.

Topaz.name: Rogue's Resurgence
Topaz.desc:
When you are below 50% health you are instantly healed for 8% of your Maximum Health.

This effect can only occur once every 20 seconds.

Topaz.name: Blessing of the Virtuoso
Topaz.desc: You retain +2% Haste from Spirit of Heroism while it is not active.

Topaz.name: Adrenaline Rush - II
Topaz.desc: +9% Haste for 10 seconds each time you deal damage to or heal a character that has 30% or less health.

Topaz.name: Rogue's Resurgence - II
Topaz.desc:
When you are below 50% health you are instantly healed for 24% of your Maximum Health.

This effect can only occur once every 20 seconds.

Topaz.name: Blessing of the Virtuoso - II
Topaz.desc: You retain +6% Haste from Spirit of Heroism while it is not active.
